Name: Farm Store Terminal
Author: snwfox9
Description:
[b]Farm Store Terminal[/b] is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that adds a craftable terminal you can place anywhere to access unlocked shops at any time.
Interacting with the terminal brings up a list of shops based on the game’s shop data. Selecting one opens the [b]original vanilla shop menu[/b], meaning prices, stock, progression, and modded behavior are preserved exactly as intended.

⚠ [b]Important Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod is [b]not fully lore-friendly[/b].
Because it relies on shop data rather than world presence, some shops may become accessible even if you haven’t physically visited their location yet. Nothing is permanently unlocked, but this can slightly break immersion for some players.[*]This mod is provided [b]as-is[/b].
While it has been tested and works as intended, I don’t plan to actively maintain or frequently update it. Bug reports are welcome, but please understand that fixes may not be immediate.[/list]To keep the shop list clean and practical, barter-based or item-exchange shops are filtered out by default. Special shops like [b]Krobus[/b] and [b]Mr. Qi[/b] are still supported, and festival shops will only appear on the actual festival day if they use gold.
The terminal is designed to stay out of the way: it doesn’t change balance, doesn’t modify shop inventories, and doesn’t add new mechanics. It simply offers a centralized, convenient way to access shops when you need them.
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+, and most mods that add shops using the standard shop data system.


[b]Installation[/b]
This mod consists of [b]two parts[/b], both of which are required:
[list]
[*][b]FarmStoreTerminal[/b] (SMAPI code)
[*][b]FarmStoreTerminalContent[/b] (Content Patcher pack)
[/list][b]Option 1: Nexus Mod Manager / Vortex (Recommended)[/b][list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/b]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*]Install with [b]Vortex[/b]
[*]Launch the game through [b]SMAPI[/b]
[/list]Vortex will automatically install [b]both folders[/b] into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] directory.

[b]Option 2: Manual Installation[/b][list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/b]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*]Download and extract the mod archive
[*]Place [b]both folders[/b] into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods [/b]directory.
[/list]

[b]Permissions[/b]
You’re free to repost or include this mod elsewhere — no need to ask for permission.
Just make sure to credit the original source.
